units.source_text: “光华公子源氏”（光源氏），只此名称是堂皇的；

en.t: The name “the radiant Prince Genji” (Hikaru Genji) alone was magnificent;

units.source_text: 其实此人一生遭受世间讥评的瑕疵甚多。

en.t: in truth, this man had many flaws throughout his life that drew criticism from the world.

units.source_text: 尤其是那些好色行为，他自己深恐流传后世，赢得轻佻浮薄之名，因而竭力隐秘，却偏偏众口流传。

en.t: Especially regarding his amorous conduct, he himself deeply feared that it would be passed down to later generations and earn him a reputation for frivolity, so he tried his utmost to conceal it, yet it spread all the more from mouth to mouth.

units.source_text: 这真是人之多言，亦可畏也。

en.t: This truly shows that people’s talk can indeed be something to fear.
